d:
"Dharmik sheds light on the troubling realities of our times, where drug abuse, addictions, and the breakdown of familial respect have become rampant. As women live in constant fear and Indian culture, along with the Vedas, faces degradation,He uses his words to awaken society. His message is a call to action, urging people to safeguard our cultural heritage and values amidst these challenging times.
Song Credits:
Track Name: Fikar
Written & Performed By: Dharmik
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Dharmik
